name: Shader Packs
description: Runs an OptiFine or Iris shader pack (like Complementary or BSL) from the instance's shaderpacks folder. Needs a graphics card with OpenGL 3.3.

settings.name: Shader Pack
settings.description: The pack's .zip, or its unzipped folder, in the instance's shaderpacks folder. Options go in a .txt file named after it, as with OptiFine.

settings.name: Loader
settings.description: Which mod the pack is run as. Iris adds its own passes and lets packs check for it; packs that need Iris-only features (like compute shaders) won't load.
